note: Synthesized bhangra (make_bhangra_beat.py), 112 BPM, swung dhol chaal. Window starts at bar 2 (analysis beat 3 = 2.14 s; the downbeat guess was low-confidence so bars are set from the score). Choreographed by Claude.

segments.note: bars 2-4, dhol alone: shoulder bounce on every beat
bars 5-8, tumbi + 'hoi': hands up, side to side
bars 11-12: wrist twist every 2 beats (1 beat is too fast to read at 112 BPM)
bars 13-14, dhol roll build: big sweep
bar 15 into the finale 'hoi' (beat 56): accent hits every 2 beats, back to ready
